items.question: How many weeks of practical experience must students in the Dual Learning model of the UAE's Professional and Practical Training Programme for Emirati students complete?
items.fact: Dual Learning model requires eight weeks practical experience

items.question: How many students took part in the pilot phase of the UAE's Professional and Practical Training Programme for Emirati students?
items.fact: Pilot phase brought together 3,500 students from various education stages
